messages:
clare: heads up — after the 11:00 webinar promo we saw ~40 leads stuck as unassigned for ~2m. posting logs.
noah: confirmed. looks like enrichment webhook slowed then returned 502 repeatedly. RR slot expires before enrichment returns so fallback didn’t claim.
sasha: can we fast-fail the enrichment gate for high-velocity sources? proposal: if source=="webinar" and enrichment_elapsed > 8s -> assign to default-owner and tag lead.enrich_state=pending.
clare: +1. also add metric leads.fallback.enrich_pending so we can count. want to avoid reassign loops though.
noah: quick mitigation: change HS workflow retry policy to linear 3s x 2 and reduce RR wait from 30s to 8s for tags [webinar, pql]. will run a small canary.
revops-bot: creating ticket REV-4891: hs workflow wf-webinar-2026 healthcheck + retry config. assigned to @noah.
ops-bot: deploy-plan: canary 5% marketing traffic us-west1 for 20m. metric gates: fallback_rate < 3% and handoff_latency_95p < 30s. CI ref ci-9021.
sasha: also add playbook note: if lead.enrich_state==pending and enrichment arrives within 10m, trigger hs-backfill to reassign to original owner and tag requeued_after_enrich.
clare: please also add slack alert for marketing-oncall if leads.unowned > 30 for 15m during promos.
ops-bot: alert rule created alert-7812.
noah: rolling patch now, will report numbers in here.
clare: thanks — will update the webinar launch checklist and the inbound handoff SLA doc after canary.
